stories.title: Expose Specialty Identification via Tool Router
stories.description: Add a tool definition and routing logic to expose specialty identification as a callable backend capability, including input validation, tool registration, and response formatting.

stories.title: Integrate Specialty Mapping into FindCare Facade

stories.title: Implement Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Identification
stories.description: Create comprehensive tests covering schema validation, specialty_service logic (regex + vector), ambiguity handling, and end-to-end flow through tool router and facade.
